title: 聊聊我的家人
subtitle: My family and friends
description: 这段对话帮你练习用A2口语介绍家人、朋友和周末活动，KET常考这类日常话题。
examPart: 话题拓展｜认识我的家人
examTip:
**考法** 在KET口语考试中，“家庭与朋友”是Part 1常考话题，考官可能会问“Who do you live with?”或“Tell me about your best friend.”。这段是生活对话拓展，不是真实Speaking Part 1考场流程。真实Part 1是考官问、考生答。
**掌握** 核心句型：There is/are… / I live with… / I’m closest to… / My best friend’s name is… / We often… / I like/love doing…
**注意** 回答时切勿只蹦单词，要用完整短句，比如“I live with my mum and dad.”，而不是只说“Mum and dad.”。

templates.en: There are ___ people in my family.

sentences.en: How many people are there in your family, Lily?
sentences.zh: 莉莉，你家有几口人？

sentences.en: There are four. I live with my parents and my little brother.
sentences.zh: 四口人。我和父母还有弟弟住在一起。

sentences.en: Who are you closest to in your family?
sentences.zh: 家里你和谁最亲？

sentences.en: I'm closest to my mum because she always listens to me.
sentences.zh: 我和妈妈最亲，因为她总是听我说话。

sentences.en: What's your best friend's name?
sentences.zh: 你最好的朋友叫什么名字？

sentences.en: Her name's Amy. We like playing together.
sentences.zh: 她叫艾米。我们喜欢一起玩。

sentences.en: What do you do with your family and friends at weekends?
sentences.zh: 周末你和家人朋友都做什么？

sentences.en: We often go to the park or have a picnic.
sentences.zh: 我们经常去公园或者野餐。

title: 聊聊日常作息
subtitle: Daily routine
description: Tom和Lily聊日常作息，练询问起床睡觉，对比周末活动，掌握KET时间表达。
examPart: 话题拓展｜日常作息对话
examTip:
**考法** 在 A2 Key / KET 口语中，"日常作息"常出现在 Part 1 的个人信息问答中，考官可能会问 "What time do you get up?" "How do you go to school?" 或 "What do you do at weekends?"。这段是生活对话拓展，不是真实 Speaking Part 1 考场流程。真实 Part 1 是考官问、考生答，不是两个学生互相采访。
**掌握** 需掌握的核心 A2 句型/词汇：What time...? / I usually... / I walk to school / I go to school by... / At weekends, I... / like doing / so I can... / get up, go to bed, have breakfast。
**注意** 回答时使用完整短句，如 "I get up at 7 o'clock."，不要只说 "7 o'clock."，这样更符合 KET 口语中的完整回答要求。

sentences.en: What time do you usually get up on school days?
sentences.zh: 你上学日通常几点起床？

sentences.en: I get up at seven and have a quick breakfast.
sentences.zh: 我七点起床，然后很快地吃早餐。

sentences.en: How do you go to school in the morning?
sentences.zh: 你早上怎么去上学？

sentences.en: I usually walk to school with my best friend.
sentences.zh: 我通常和我最好的朋友走路去学校。

sentences.en: At weekends, I sleep late. What about you?
sentences.zh: 周末我会睡懒觉。你呢？

sentences.en: I like to play outside with my friends at the weekend.
sentences.zh: 我周末喜欢和朋友们在外面玩。

sentences.en: What time do you go to bed?
sentences.zh: 你几点睡觉？

sentences.en: I go to bed at nine, so I can get up early.
sentences.zh: 我九点睡觉，这样我就能早起。

title: 聊聊天气和季节
subtitle: Weather & seasons
description: 练一练问今天天气、说说你最喜欢的季节，KET 话题里常聊不同天气穿什么、能做什么活动。
examTip:
**考法** 天气与季节是 A2 Key / KET 常见生活话题，可能出现在 Part 1 的个人问答中，也可以作为 Part 2 讨论图片或提示时的相关表达。请注意，这段是生活对话拓展，不是真实 Speaking Part 1 考场流程。真实 Part 1 是考官问、考生答，不是两个学生互相聊天。
**掌握** What's the weather like? / It's sunny and warm. / I like spring because... / I can wear... / I love doing... / In summer, I often...
**注意** 回答时用完整短句，比如 "It's raining."，不要只说 "Rain."；可以加一个简单原因，让回答更丰富。

templates.en: I like ___ because it's ___ and I can ___.
templates.zh: 说喜欢哪个季节及原因

templates.en: My favourite season is ___ because I love ___.

sentences.en: What's the weather like today?
sentences.zh: 今天天气怎么样？

sentences.en: It's sunny and warm. Great for a walk!
sentences.zh: 天气晴朗温暖。很适合散步！

sentences.en: Yes, I love sunny days. What's your favourite season?
sentences.zh: 是啊，我喜欢晴天。你最喜欢的季节是什么？

sentences.en: I like spring because flowers are everywhere.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢春天，因为到处是花。

sentences.en: Spring is nice! What do you wear in spring?
sentences.zh: 春天很棒！你春天穿什么？

sentences.en: I wear a light jacket and jeans.
sentences.zh: 我穿薄夹克和牛仔裤。

sentences.en: And what do you like doing in spring?
sentences.zh: 那你春天喜欢做什么？

sentences.en: I love flying kites in the park.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢在公园放风筝。

title: 聊聊健康吧
subtitle: Stay healthy
description: 这段对话练习如何表达身体不舒服、询问情况，以及谈论保持健康的方法，KET 常考健康话题。
examTip:
**考法** 健康话题在 A2 Key / KET 口语中常出现，比如考官可能会问 "How do you stay healthy?" 或 "What do you do when you're ill?" 这段是生活对话拓展，不是真实 Speaking Part 1 考场流程。真实 Part 1 是考官问、考生答，不是两个学生互相聊天。
**掌握** 核心 A2 句型/词：I've got a… / Do you need to see a doctor? / You should… / What do you do to stay healthy? / I ride my bike… / eat fruit / do exercise / stay healthy
**注意** 回答时尽量用完整短句，比如 "I've got a headache."，不要只说 "Headache."，这样更符合 KET 口语中完整回答的要求。

templates.zh: 问对方每天做什么保持健康

sentences.en: Hi, how are you feeling today?
sentences.zh: 嗨，你今天感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: Not so good. I've got a headache.
sentences.zh: 不太好。我头疼。

sentences.en: Oh dear. Do you need to see a doctor?
sentences.zh: 哎呀。你需要看医生吗？

sentences.en: I think I'll just rest for now.
sentences.zh: 我想我现在就休息一下。

sentences.en: You should drink some water and lie down.
sentences.zh: 你应该喝点水，躺下。

sentences.en: Thanks. What do you do to stay healthy?
sentences.zh: 谢谢。你做什么来保持健康？

sentences.en: I ride my bike every day and eat fruit.
sentences.zh: 我每天骑自行车，也吃水果。

sentences.en: That's great. I need to do more exercise too.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。我也需要多锻炼。

title: 聊聊我温馨的家
subtitle: My home
description: 练习描述住所、房间数量和最喜欢的房间，KET 常考家庭介绍话题。
examTip:
**考法** KET 口语 Part 1 可能问到关于家的问题，如 Where do you live? How many rooms are there? 这段是生活对话拓展，不是真实 Speaking Part 1 考场流程。真实 Part 1 是考官问、考生答。
**掌握** 核心 A2 句型/词：I live in a… / There are… / My favourite room is… / I’ve got… / because… / flat / house / garden / bedroom / living room / cosy
**注意** 回答用完整短句，别只蹦单词，比如问 Where do you live? 要答 I live in a flat. 而不是只说 Flat。

templates.zh: 描述住所类型，如公寓或房子

templates.en: There are ___ rooms in my home.
My favourite room is the ___ because ___.
templates.zh: 说明最喜欢的房间及原因

templates.en: I have got a ___ in my room.
templates.zh: 描述自己房间里的物品

sentences.en: Hi, Lily! Where do you live?
sentences.zh: 嗨，莉莉！你住在哪里？

sentences.en: I live in a flat near the park. And you?
sentences.zh: 我住在公园附近的一套公寓里。你呢？

sentences.en: I live in a house with a garden.
sentences.zh: 我住在一栋带花园的房子里。

sentences.en: That's nice! How many rooms are there?
sentences.zh: 真好！有多少个房间？

sentences.en: There are five rooms. My favourite is my bedroom.
sentences.zh: 有五个房间。我最喜欢的是我的卧室。

sentences.en: What's in your bedroom?
sentences.zh: 你的卧室里有什么？

sentences.en: I've got a big desk and some posters on the wall.
sentences.zh: 我有一张大书桌，墙上挂着一些海报。

sentences.en: Cool! I like my living room because it's cosy.
sentences.zh: 酷！我喜欢我家的客厅，因为那里很舒适。

title: 我的宠物朋友
subtitle: Furry Friends
description: 练习谈论有没有宠物、描述宠物外貌和爱好，KET口语动物话题常考内容。
examPart: 话题拓展｜说说我的宠物
examTip:
**考法** 在KET口语中，动物与宠物是常考话题。考官可能问“Do you have any pets?”或“What's your favourite animal?”。请注意，这段对话是生活对话拓展，模拟朋友聊天，不是真实Speaking Part 1考场流程。真实Part 1是考官问、考生答。
**掌握** 应重点掌握询问和描述宠物的句型：Do you have...? / I've got... / What does... look like? / ... likes doing...；以及常用形容词：friendly, cute, white, big, small 等。
**注意** 回答时要使用完整短句，如“I have a cat.”，不要只说“cat”。尝试用“because”简单解释原因。

templates.en: I don't have a pet, but I love ___.
templates.zh: 说我没有宠物但喜欢什么动物

sentences.en: Do you have any pets?
sentences.zh: 你有宠物吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I have a cat. Her name is Mimi.
sentences.zh: 有，我有一只猫。她叫咪咪。

sentences.en: What does she look like?
sentences.zh: 她长什么样？

sentences.en: She's white with big blue eyes.
sentences.zh: 她是白色的，有一双大大的蓝眼睛。

sentences.en: What does she like doing?
sentences.zh: 她喜欢做什么？

sentences.en: She loves playing with a ball.
sentences.zh: 她喜欢玩球。

sentences.en: I don't have a pet, but I like dogs.
sentences.zh: 我没有宠物，但我喜欢狗。

sentences.en: Dogs are great. They are very friendly.
sentences.zh: 狗很棒。它们非常友好。
